schemaNote: Ledger of the real evidence behind every token, asset role, contract and template claim in this package. `source` is "path:startLine-endLine" relative to the SOURCE PROJECT, which is NOT shipped inside this package. extraction/verify_all.py check [i] resolves every citation - line range AND stored quote - against the real file, but only while the source project sits beside this folder; with no sibling tree it prints a WARN and skips them, which is a warning, not a failure. Citations that point INTO this package (prefix "design-repo/") are always checked.
sourceRootNote: Paths are relative to the cloned project root that contains src/, public/, index.html, package.json and CLONE_SPEC.md.

citationKinds.declaration: Quoted directly from a CSS, JSX or JS declaration at the cited location.
citationKinds.counted: A count derived by a histogram or a regex sweep; the cited line is one representative occurrence and the count itself is stated in the note or in the token's usage field.
citationKinds.spec-measured: A value measured against the live original during the clone build and recorded in the project's own CLONE_SPEC.md; the cited line is that record.
citationKinds.inferred: An ABSENCE claim or a reading inferred from the evidence (no box-shadows, no reduced-motion CSS, no remote assets, a preserved upstream bug). The note always says how it was verified. An absence claim may carry `absenceOf` instead of `quote`: check [i] then asserts the named string does NOT appear in the cited range, which is a real check rather than a comment.

evidenceLevels.measured: Structure, layout, motion and copy measured against the live original. Routes: /, /404. The homepage pixel audit verified 1382/1382 elements at 1440px and 962/962 at 390px with zero deltas.
evidenceLevels.measured-scaffolding-placeholder-prose: DOM scaffolding measured against the live original, but the body prose is DELIBERATE PLACEHOLDER FILLER - shipping another company's policy text is a liability. Routes: /privacy-policy, /terms-of-service. A word budget derived from these pages measures the filler, NOT real copy.
evidenceLevels.composed-not-measured: No source existed to measure: app.fourmula.ai is a Next.js app emitting BAILOUT_TO_CLIENT_SIDE_RENDERING with an empty shell (11-18 characters of body text, zero forms, zero inputs). Routes: /start, /auth. These are ORIGINAL COMPOSITIONS from this project's own design system and are NOT evidence about fourmula.ai.
evidenceLevels.rule: Recorded per route and per template and NEVER flattened. Two routes that share a node list do not share an evidence level.

correctionsToPriorGroundwork.claim: CLONE_SPEC.md:71 - "Accent used by the flash-word reveals: rgb(249, 74, 0)".
correctionsToPriorGroundwork.finding: rgb(249,74,0) appears ZERO times in src/. There are FOUR flash colours, set at runtime: #F94A00, #FD7B03, #FFFFFF and var(--fonts-100), in m23.js, m24.js and m25.js. m22.js carries no colour - it is the word splitter.

correctionsToPriorGroundwork.claim: CLONE_SPEC.md:107 - the dots field has "732 dots".
correctionsToPriorGroundwork.finding: 728. Verified three ways: grep -c 'className="dot"' Footer.jsx = 728; data-row spans 0-13 and data-col 0-51 so 14 x 52 = 728; the highest data-index is 727. m07.js's own COLS x ROWS arithmetic agrees.

Tailwind is INSTALLED BUT DELIBERATELY UNUSED. src/index.css:6-11 removed the @tailwind directives with a comment explaining that Preflight broke the ported cascade. tailwind.config.js and postcss.config.js remain on disk, inert. This is not a Tailwind project.
51 local references, all resolving: 41 .avif + 2 .webp images, 3 videos, 2 fonts, 2 SVGs and 1 favicon. 75 files sit on disk, 24 of them referenced by nothing.

correctionsToPriorGroundwork.claim: Groundwork - the step gradients are a three-variant set (.is-first / .is-second / .is-third).
correctionsToPriorGroundwork.finding: There are FOUR: .is-fourth is linear-gradient(#9a0101, #fd7b03). A fifth gradient, the shared .list__main__bottom-gradient scrim (#fc730300 -> #fc7303), was also unrecorded.

correctionsToPriorGroundwork.claim: Groundwork - #progress lives inside Footer, so it is absent from the 404.
correctionsToPriorGroundwork.finding: #progress lives in src/components/Header.jsx:23 (the only occurrence in src/), and Layout renders Header unconditionally, so it IS present on the 404. Only #dotsField (Footer.jsx:85) is genuinely absent.

Neither does. Both pass only `current` to Layout (Start.jsx:15, Auth.jsx:17), so they inherit Layout's `preloader = false` default. Layout.jsx's own docstring table omits both routes, which is why this had to be read from the real call sites.

767px is 5 and min-width:768px is 2 once all three CSS sources are counted: the inline <style> block inside src/components/Footer.jsx adds one of each for the dots field. 991px=5, 479px=4 and min-width:992px=1 are confirmed.

correctionsToPriorGroundwork.claim: Groundwork - public/assets contains 2 .svg files (the radio and checkbox checkmarks).
correctionsToPriorGroundwork.finding: 23. Two sit at the assets root and are the only two anything references (both from CSS url()); the other 21 live under public/assets/svg/ and are referenced by nothing - every glyph, logo and wordmark is inlined as <svg> in the JSX instead. They still carry the same brand and third-party marks and inherit the same generationPolicy.

correctionsToPriorGroundwork.claim: Groundwork - "zero external links"; the only remaining http:// strings are SVG xmlns namespaces.
correctionsToPriorGroundwork.finding: True for http: and https: in href/src, and the xmlns claim needs one addition: src/loadSite.js:5 also holds a commented-out cdnjs URL documenting the original's 404ing ScrambleTextPlugin. The two mailto: hrefs this ledger once recorded in the legal pages' filler prose (TermsContent.jsx, PrivacyContent.jsx) no longer exist in src/ (`grep -rn mailto src public` returns zero), so the claim is now true for every scheme; NO_EXTERNAL_LINKS still rejects every scheme.

correctionsToPriorGroundwork.claim: Groundwork - #146ef5 is the Finsweet cookie component's hover accent.
correctionsToPriorGroundwork.finding: Correct that it is vendored and not a brand colour, but it is not hover-only: it is also the CHECKED state fill of .fs-cc_checkbox-button. Three more vendored Finsweet colours were unrecorded: #468df7, #f8f8f8 and #0000001a.

correctionsToPriorGroundwork.claim: Groundwork - the source ships no prefers-reduced-motion handling at all.
correctionsToPriorGroundwork.finding: Almost: handling is PARTIAL. public/motion/m27.js reads the media query to gate background-video autoplay. No stylesheet has a prefers-reduced-motion rule and nothing else in the project reads it. So the background-video slot's reducedMotionFallback MIRRORS real behaviour and every other section's is a design rule this repository prescribes - the contracts state which per section.

The .body class block. It carries the DARK palette values.
The .body.dark block. It carries the LIGHT palette values - the class literally named "dark" selects the light palette.
The shipped body element carries both classes, so .body.dark wins and the DEFAULT RENDERED THEME IS LIGHT.
m10.js toggles only the class 'dark' and readInitial() defaults to true, so the page starts on .body.dark, i.e. the LIGHT palette, while the toggle reports data-theme-state="dark".

m11.js initialises from a class ('light') that m10.js never sets, so this expression is always false on first paint; its theme:changed listener uses the real boolean. The scripts are verbatim copies and are read-only, so the resulting first-paint vs post-toggle asymmetry is recorded, not fixed.
